text:
ana: Quick design review — routing editor preview is showing stale order after a reorder. Can someone look? TL;DR: drag reorder, open preview, preview still used old order.

mike: Saw this. Repro steps?

ana: Repro: create 3 rules (A,B,C). Drag B to top. Open 'Simulate' -> preview results still show A at top. Happens when sim runs or if sim is open during reorder.

jin: Looks like the UI is optimistic for reorder but preview reads from the sim snapshot that's not updated. I can add a flush on drop:end. Also noticed tabindex on drag handles disappears during drag (a11y).

carla: Root cause might be server snapshot + local optimistic reorder mismatch. Preview currently reads from server cache; we should either snapshot on sim start or block sim while unsaved reorders exist.

mike: UX question: should preview follow live edits or snapshot at the moment you start sim? I prefer snapshot-on-start — deterministic for debugging.

ana: Agree. Also the current toggle label 'Live preview' vs 'Snapshot' is ambiguous. Proposed copy: 'Preview follows live edits' / 'Preview snapshot at start'.

jin: Implementation note: snapshot-on-start is easiest. We'll show a small banner when sim started: 'Preview snapshot from 14:03 — edits since will not affect this run.' For keyboard/a11y, we should announce reorder moves with aria-live: 'Rule "B - login" moved to position 1'.

mike: Also want a validation hint: when a rule is shadowed by a higher-priority catch-all, show an inline warning next to the rule header reading 'Shadowed by higher-priority rule'. Short and scannable.

carla: +1. Add a 'Why this matters' link to docs. For sim UX it'd be helpful to show per-rule hit counts (micro-heatbar) and percentages so users can see which rules matched in the snapshot.

ana: Mock idea: tiny horizontal bar under each rule with hits % and tooltip with absolute counts. Sim start should also store a deterministic seed so sampling is reproducible between runs.

jin: Edge case: deleting a rule while sim running currently causes a 500 in the preview service. I'll guard deletes to pause the sim and surface toast: 'Preview paused — rule set changed'. Also add e2e for delete-while-sim.

mike: :thumbsup: Love the 'paused' toast. Ensure it's keyboard focusable and dismissible (a11y). Also toast shouldn't steal focus from active editor field.

aria-bot: Staging: canary build with reorder->flush and preview-snapshot behavior will be deployed at 2026-03-24T09:30Z (build 2026.03.24-canary-5).

carla: I'll pick up e2e tests (reorder flush, snapshot determinism). Jin, can you add unit tests for the reorder commit hook?

jin: Yep. I'll open a PR to eng-runtime branch and tag @carla for review. Quick snippet I'll add for the drop handler:

`````
// onDropEnd
commitReorder().then(() => {
  flushSimCache(); // ensure preview reads latest order
});
`````

mike: Mike: Can you update Figma copy: 'Preview follows live edits' -> 'Preview follows live edits (non-deterministic)'; 'Snapshot at start' -> 'Snapshot at start (recommended for debugging)'.

ana: Thanks everyone. Action items: Mike -> figma copy + inline warning copy; Jin -> PR + unit tests + guard on deletes; Carla -> e2e tests + doc link; I'll schedule a 10am sync tomorrow.

mike: Sounds good. See you tomorrow.
